resources.string: Speak on your phone. Type on your computer.
Type with your phone keyboard, or use its microphone to dictate.
Connect a computer to send text
Changes the interface language. Your text stays as is.
Open Pair phone on the computer. Scan its QR code or enter its address and 8-digit code.
Scan the QR code shown by SayIn on your computer
Keep this screen open and approve this phone on the computer.
Enable receiving in the computer app first.
Another phone is the active input device.
Ready · text follows the current computer cursor.
Remove this phone’s saved credentials? Pending requests remain linked to the old authorization. This does not revoke the device on the computer.
Allow local network access in system app settings, then try again.
Text to send (line breaks and tabs become spaces):
Up to 4,000 characters / 16 KiB per request. No Enter key is added.
Received means the computer has the request. Input submitted means input events were dispatched; verify the target content if needed. Text history is encrypted on this phone.
No receipt is available yet. Query the original request before deciding what to do; do not send another copy.
Check the target content and resume receiving on the computer. This request will not retry.
Pairing failed. Check the address and code, or open a new pairing window on the computer.
Connection closed. Check Wi-Fi, the computer and its firewall permission, then reconnect.
Protected storage could not be opened or saved. Sending is disabled. Keep app data for recovery.
Text contains unsupported characters or exceeds the request limit.
The local pending queue is full (16 requests / 64 KiB). Resolve pending requests first.
Enable receiving in the computer app, then click the field where you want to type.
The request could not be completed. Check the computer, then reconnect to query its receipt.
This device does not provide TLS 1.3. Android 10 or later is required with the default security provider.
Received, not yet entered. Waiting for earlier requests in order. Expires 30 seconds after acceptance.
Not entered; the request expired. Old text will not be typed later. Place the cursor in your target field and send a new request.
Not entered: the foreground check failed or input is paused. Check the computer and handle this item. Expires 30 seconds after acceptance; no automatic retry.
SayIn was in front when sent; no input. Switch to your target field.
No usable foreground window; no input. Click your target field.
The target has higher permissions than SayIn; no input. Use a target with normal permissions, or start SayIn with matching permissions.
Ctrl, Shift, Alt, or Windows key is held; no input. Release the key.
The session or input desktop is unavailable; no input. Unlock and return to your user desktop.
Camera access was denied. Allow it in system app settings, or use a pairing code.
The camera could not open. Close the scanner and use a pairing code, or try again.
Scan the pairing QR code on your computer.
Texts are sent to your paired computer over the LAN. Local recognition stays on this phone. If you select cloud recognition, audio and hotwords go directly to your chosen provider.
Use your existing keyboard and its voice input
Review, then send to the computer cursor · No Enter added
Requests and receipts appear here after sending
While SayIn is in the foreground
Offline recognition is planned. No model is installed yet.
Floating entry and persistent notification are planned.
%1$s Expires 30 seconds after acceptance; no automatic retry.
%1$s This request has expired and will not be typed later. Send a new request if needed.
Use up to 4,000 characters without control characters.
Your words appear here. You can edit or add more before sending.
Recognizes Chinese and English on this phone. Tap Start speaking.
No speech recognized. Your previous draft is kept.
Listening… Tap Finish when you are done.
Allow microphone access to use on-device recognition. You can also use your keyboard.
Recognition could not load. Try again, or use your keyboard.
Microphone unavailable. Check microphone access and other recording apps.
Recognition could not keep up and stopped. Check the draft before sending.
Recognition stopped unexpectedly. Check the draft or try again.
Sending in %1$d s · Tap Edit to cancel
Confirm the keyboard suggestion to finish input.
Finish input to check whether this short text can be sent automatically.
Type, or use voice input on your keyboard.
Long text · review and send manually.
Contains English · review and send manually.
Edited text · review and send manually.
Draft kept. Connect your computer, then send manually.

When you select Cloud and start recording, audio and hotwords are sent directly to Volcengine for recognition. Credentials are encrypted on this phone. SayIn does not save audio. Your provider may charge for usage. Saving enables this option; it does not start recording.
One term per line, up to 20 terms and 80 characters in total. These hints are sent to Doubao; recognition is not guaranteed. The streaming service has a 100-token limit and may truncate them.
Set up Doubao in Settings before recording.
Tap to speak · audio is sent to Doubao.
The streaming service responded. Try speaking to check accuracy.
Saved on this phone. Select Cloud on the Speak page to use it.
Sends one second of generated silence using saved credentials. No microphone is used. This can incur a small charge and does not verify recognition accuracy or hotwords. Save changes before testing.
Check your credentials and hotwords (20 terms, 80 characters total).
Cannot read or save encrypted configuration. Remove it and enter your credentials again. Pairing is unaffected.
Cloud connection interrupted. Check the Internet connection, then start a new recording. The draft is kept.
Credentials were rejected. Check that the API Key or APP ID + Access Token is complete, valid and enabled.
Service limit reached. Check the provider account and quota.
Timed out waiting for the cloud service. The draft is kept; it has not been sent automatically.
The cloud response was incomplete or invalid. The draft is kept; start a new recording to retry.
The cloud service rejected this recognition session. Check the service configuration or try a new recording later.
The network cannot keep up with recording. The draft is kept. Check the connection before starting a new recording.
The connection was interrupted before verification completed. Check your Internet connection and try again.
Timed out waiting for the service response. Try again.
The service returned an invalid response; verification did not complete. Try again later.
Access denied (HTTP 403). Check your credentials and whether ASR 2.0 hourly service is enabled for this API Key’s project (or the legacy application). Projects and applications do not share access.
Check the last input on your computer
Bring your words to your computer
Open Receive in SayIn on your computer, then scan its QR code.
Establishing a secure connection. Both QR and code pairing require approval on your computer.
Using the saved pairing. No need to scan again.
Waiting for the computer. SayIn will reconnect while this app is open. Your draft stays here; reconnection does not send it.
Checking previous delivery results before allowing new sends. Old text will not be sent again automatically.
Connection is working. Check the previous text in the target app, then confirm in SayIn on your computer to avoid duplicate input.
Connection is working. Select this phone on the computer Receive page before sending.
Connection is working. Open SayIn on your computer to check its receiving status.
Connection is working. Resume receiving on the computer Receive page before sending.
Text goes to the current cursor on your computer. No need to open SayIn there.

Keep SayIn running on your computer and use a LAN that allows the devices to reach each other. Changing the Windows public/private network category is not required. Firewall rules or guest-network isolation may still block access.
Doubao · Audio sent to the cloud
Use your keyboard to enter text
On-device model loads when you start speaking
Listening · Tap to return to your session
Tap to open your voice draft
The full page and quick card share one recording and draft. Recording notifications let you finish speaking without reopening the app.
Edit the system quick settings panel and add SayIn.
Optional. Requires display-over-other-apps permission and a persistent notification. It never starts the microphone on its own.
Floating button could not start. Allow display over other apps, then try again.
Original text unavailable for this record
Up to 100 records are encrypted on this phone. No cloud history sync.
Draft storage unavailable. Keep this app open to preserve your text.
Couldn’t find your paired computer. Check that both devices are on the same local network, or update its address in connection help.
Found a possible computer, but couldn’t authenticate the connection. Your pairing is retained. Check the computer or update its address.
Static PNG or JPEG, up to 10 MiB and 16 megapixels. Orientation is applied and metadata removed. JPEG is re-encoded at quality 92.
Pasting replaces the computer clipboard. No Enter is sent; check the target app yourself.
Paste instruction submitted. Check the target app.
The image is unsupported, damaged or over the size limit. Choose a static PNG or JPEG.
The computer is not ready to paste. The image is kept; check the connection or computer reception state.
This computer does not support image input. Update its SayIn app.
Image transfer stopped. The image is kept. Check history before sending again.
Another image is awaiting a result, or storage is full. Check history first.
Upload cancelled. The image is kept.
The image was not pasted. Cancel or let it expire, then explicitly send again.
Review or edit the translation, then send it manually. The original is retained.
Translation ready. Check names, numbers, code and meaning before sending.
Translation cancelled. The original is retained.
Translation reached the output limit and is incomplete. It cannot be sent.
The original exceeds 1,024 model tokens. Shorten it and translate again.
Translation timed out. The original is retained; retry manually.
The local model is missing or failed integrity checks. Prepare it again. The original is retained.
Local translation failed. The original is retained. No cloud service was used.

Download the selected Hy-MT2 model (1.13 GB) and verify its integrity. At least 1.15 GB of additional storage is needed during preparation. Later translations run on this phone without uploading text. The download does not translate or send your draft.
Model preparation failed. Check storage and connection, then try again. Your original is retained.
